_why: DECLARED DEPENDENCIES. This child may import its own files plus these, and NOTHING else. Adding a line here is a DECISION, not a formality: anything starting with $lib, $tinyStore or $mobRoutes, or climbing into ReTreever, is a NO.
_channel_why: THE CHANNEL. One door to the host. The child names the channel, never ReTreever. A host wires its real implementation in; rapper wires a fixture. Anything the channel does not provide comes back null and the child renders nothing rather than crashing. Every $-import outside this prefix is a SECOND DOOR.
_self_contained: This is the ONE child with no $parent/siblings imports at all — it depends on no sibling child, unlike ReTreever_where (which needs getCache_OnlineMap). The host's API surface and URL map arrive as PROPS, so on rapper the lists come back empty, the links do not render, and the page still stands. That makes it the cheapest child to publish and the natural first test of any change to the publishing model.
_no_kit_import: @sveltejs/kit was removed from this list on 26 Aug 2026. resultLoad's `import { error }` was the child's only runtime import of a real package, and it broke both results pages the moment this folder became its own repo — Node resolves a bare import from the IMPORTER, which is now outside any host's node_modules. It is a prop now (WhoWhatFail), so the child imports no framework package at all. $app/* stays: those are SvelteKit VIRTUAL modules, supplied by the plugin, never resolved from node_modules, so they were never affected. RE-ADDED 1 Sep 2026 for ONE import only: hooks.ts's `import type { Reroute }`, which is erased at build and reaches no runtime. A value import from @sveltejs/kit in a child is still the bug this note describes.
_shared_tree_why: THE SHARED TREE. `$rig/…` (the mounting tier's layout and dev chrome), `$gc/…` (Get Cache theme and art) and `$rt/…` (brand assets) are three aliases every mounting tier defines, all pointing at ONE copy of the tree that lives in the tier that owns it — nothing is copied or synced, and this child never says where. Dev chrome renders only under vite dev; the assets are what a page shows. Declared here so hitch_test.sh can tell a reviewed seam from a second door. A child cloned alone defines none of the three and fails LOUDLY at build, which is the point.
